## Checklist

- [ ] One behaviour per commit, and each commit passes its own tests
- [ ] Tests added for anything that can be tested
- [ ] `dotnet build` is clean (analyzers fail the build) and `dotnet test` passes
- [ ] `packages.lock.json` files are committed if a package changed
- [ ] `README.md` updated if the API contract or the way to run the app changed
- [ ] `TODO.md` updated if this closes or opens an item
- [ ] A new decision with trade-offs has an ADR in `docs/adr`
